description: Optimization-level-2 g2 stress campaign including the deferred k=2 amplification level.
rationale: The g0 opt2 repeat resolved the original compilation-sensitive anomaly to a manageable residual bias.
The g1 opt2 stress campaign passed for k=0,1,2 and produced an MLAE absolute error of 0.000907.
g2 is the quadratic benchmark with larger canonical length and higher structural degree, so it is the next stress target.
Running g2 k=0,1,2 under the same optimization setting avoids mixing compilation regimes in the MLAE estimate.

selected_jobs.purpose: Quadratic encoding stress test with a consistent optimization_level=2 MLAE schedule.

deferred_jobs.reason: Known degeneracy at a=1/4; use only as an explicit failure-mode demonstration.

stopping_rules: Prepare this campaign without --submit and inspect g2 k=2 depth and two-qubit count.
Submit only if g2 k=2 remains within the Phase 0 risk envelope and current Runtime remaining is healthy.
If the prepared g2 k=2 circuit is substantially deeper than the original opt0 circuit or queue/backend status deteriorates, pause before submission.
If g2 k=2 returns a large deviation, move next to layout selection and mitigation rather than increasing shots or amplification depth.
